title: Right derived functors of a finite product are the product of right derived functors
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and, for each $i\in I$, let $\mathcal A_i$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions] and let $\Gamma_i: \mathcal A_i\to\mathbf{Ab}$ be an additive left exact functor [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. On the product category $\prod_{i\in I}\mathcal A_i$, the componentwise product functor $\Gamma((A_i)_i)=\prod_{i\in I}\Gamma_i(A_i)$ is additive and left exact, and its right derived functors satisfy $R^q\Gamma((A_i)_i)\cong\prod_{i\in I}R^q\Gamma_i(A_i)$ naturally for every $q\ge0$.

source.place: first paragraph of the proof of Lemma 0A5B (etale-cohomology-lemma-constant-smooth-statements), finite-product assembly; derived-functor formulation supplied explicitly

proof.text: For each i choose an injective resolution $A_i\to J_i^\bullet$. The product-category statement [lem-weil-pbc-finite-product-injective-resolutions] says that the product category is abelian with enough injectives and that the componentwise complex $\prod_iJ_i^\bullet$ is an injective resolution of $(A_i)_i$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-product-functor-left-exact], the componentwise product functor $\Gamma$ is additive and left exact, which is the first assertion of the statement; hence its right derived functors are defined, and by the definition of right derived functors in [def-sp-left-exact-additive] (with the injective-resolution notion of [def-sp-injective-resolutions]) $R^q\Gamma((A_i)_i)$ can be computed from this single product resolution.

source.place: Section 0156 (Right derived functors and injective resolutions); finite-product assembly supplied by the worker

proof.text: Applying $\Gamma$ degreewise to this product resolution gives the componentwise product complex $\prod_i\Gamma_i(J_i^\bullet)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-product-complex-cohomology], its q-th cohomology is naturally $\prod_i\mathcal H^q(\Gamma_i(J_i^\bullet))$. By the definition of right derived functors in [def-sp-left-exact-additive], these terms are $\prod_iR^q\Gamma_i(A_i)$ on the right and $R^q\Gamma((A_i)_i)$ on the left. The cohomology identification is induced by the coordinate projections and therefore is natural in the family and in morphisms of the functors, proving the asserted natural isomorphism for every q.
